name: phoxite
description: PHP and Laravel code intelligence: completion, navigation, usages, rename, refactorings, formatting, inspections and Laravel support (routes, views, config, translations, validation, Eloquent, Blade).

phoxite.server.path.markdownDescription: The `phoxite-lsp` executable. Empty: the one bundled with the extension.

phoxite.phpVersion.markdownDescription: The PHP version the code is checked against, e.g. `8.3`. Empty: from `composer.json` (`config.platform.php`, else the lowest version `require.php` allows), else the latest.

phoxite.includePaths.markdownDescription: Folders outside the project whose code is indexed too: absolute, `~/…`, or relative to the project.

phoxite.stubs.markdownDescription: Extra phpstorm-stubs sets (`redis`, `swoole`, `wordpress`…) on top of the defaults and the `ext-*` requirements of `composer.json`.

phoxite.exclude.markdownDescription: Globs of files and folders left out of the index (`node_modules`, `/storage`). `null`: `node_modules`, `.git`, `storage/framework` and `bootstrap/cache`. `vendor` is read through Composer's `installed.json` either way.

phoxite.inspections.markdownDescription: Per-inspection settings by id, e.g. `{ "PhpUndefinedMethod": { "enabled": false }, "PhpTypeMismatch": { "strict": true, "severity": "error" } }`. The key `*` with `enabled: false` turns every inspection off.

strict.description: Type and call checks: also report what can't be proven.

phoxite.laravel.detection.markdownDescription: Laravel support: `auto` when `composer.json` requires `laravel/framework`, the lock file lists it, or `artisan` exists.

phoxite.laravel.routeHints.markdownDescription: Code lenses on controller methods listing their routes, and the full URI after each route registration.

phoxite.laravel.modules.markdownDescription: Which modules of a modular application are read: `nwidart/laravel-modules`, module folders (`modules/`, `app-modules/`…), both (`auto`), or none.

phoxite.laravel.inertiaPages.markdownDescription: Folders of Inertia pages, relative to the project. Empty: the `ide.json` page paths, else `resources/js/Pages`.

phoxite.format.lineWidth.markdownDescription: The line length Format Document tries to stay within.

phoxite.warnAboutOtherServers.markdownDescription: Warn when another PHP language server (Intelephense, PHP Intelephense, Phpactor) is active too: both would answer every request.
